# An if chain that assigns a temporary becomes a new version of it, a select of each
# branch's value where a path that assigns nothing keeps the version before. That is
# how hard sigmoid and hard swish are written: t := x[i] + 3, then clamp t with
# if/else if, then use it. Results must match the scalar loop bit for bit, NaN,
# infinities and signed zeros included.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func HardSwish(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i] + 3
		if t < 0 {
			t = 0
		} else if t > 6 {
			t = 6
		}
		dst[i] = x[i] * t / 6
	}
}

func HardSigmoid(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i] + 3
		if t < 0 {
			t = 0
		}
		if t > 6 {
			t = 6
		}
		dst[i] = t / 6
	}
}

func ClampInt(dst, x []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i]
		if t < lo {
			t = lo
		} else if t > hi {
			t = hi
		}
		dst[i] = t
	}
}

// SiLU is x*sigmoid(x), which needs exp. These two replace sigmoid with an
// approximation built from arithmetic: x/(1+|x|) scaled into (0,1), and a cubic
// polynomial of x clamped to [-2,2], where it still rises. They are about the
// same shape as SiLU, not equal to it; the test checks the rewrite, not the accuracy.
func SiLUSoftsign(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		a := x[i]
		if a < 0 {
			a = -a
		}
		dst[i] = x[i] * (0.5 + 0.5*x[i]/(1+a))
	}
}

func SiLUCubic(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		c := x[i]
		if c < -2 {
			c = -2
		} else if c > 2 {
			c = 2
		}
		s := 0.5 + c/4 - c*c*c/48
		dst[i] = x[i] * s
	}
}

// The condition reads a second temporary, and a branch value reads the first.
func Mixed(dst, x []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		a := x[i] * 2
		b := a + 1
		if b > 10 && a < 100 {
			a = a - b
		} else if b < -10 {
			a = -a
		}
		dst[i] = a + b
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func HardSwish(dst, x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(3)
	_vcFloat32s0_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcFloat32s0_4 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(6)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			t := x[i] + 3
			if t < 0 {
				t = 0
			} else if t > 6 {
				t = 6
			}
			dst[i] = x[i] * t / 6
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1.Add(_vcFloat32s0_1)
				_t2 := _vcFloat32s0_2.IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcFloat32s0_2), _vcFloat32s0_4.IfElse(_t1.Greater(_vcFloat32s0_4), _t1))
				_v1.Mul(_t2).Div(_vcFloat32s0_4).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func HardSigmoid(dst, x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s1_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(3)
	_vcFloat32s1_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcFloat32s1_4 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(6)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			t := x[i] + 3
			if t < 0 {
				t = 0
			}
			if t > 6 {
				t = 6
			}
			dst[i] = t / 6
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1.Add(_vcFloat32s1_1)
				_t2 := _vcFloat32s1_2.IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcFloat32s1_2), _t1)
				_t3 := _vcFloat32s1_4.IfElse(_t2.Greater(_vcFloat32s1_4), _t2)
				_t3.Div(_vcFloat32s1_4).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func ClampInt(dst, x []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	_vcInt32s2_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(lo)
	_vcInt32s2_3 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(hi)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			t := x[i]
			if t < lo {
				t = lo
			} else if t > hi {
				t = hi
			}
			dst[i] = t
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1
				_t2 := _vcInt32s2_1.IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcInt32s2_1), _vcInt32s2_3.IfElse(_t1.Greater(_vcInt32s2_3), _t1))
				_t2.StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

// SiLU is x*sigmoid(x), which needs exp. These two replace sigmoid with an
// approximation built from arithmetic: x/(1+|x|) scaled into (0,1), and a cubic
// polynomial of x clamped to [-2,2], where it still rises. They are about the
// same shape as SiLU, not equal to it; the test checks the rewrite, not the accuracy.
func SiLUSoftsign(dst, x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s3_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcFloat32s3_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0.5)
	_vcFloat32s3_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			a := x[i]
			if a < 0 {
				a = -a
			}
			dst[i] = x[i] * (0.5 + 0.5*x[i]/(1+a))
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1
				_t2 := _t1.Neg().IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcFloat32s3_1), _t1)
				_v1.Mul(_vcFloat32s3_2).Div(_t2.Add(_vcFloat32s3_3)).Add(_vcFloat32s3_2).Mul(_v1).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func SiLUCubic(dst, x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s4_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(-2)
	_vcFloat32s4_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(2)
	_vcFloat32s4_5 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(48)
	_vcFloat32s4_6 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(4)
	_vcFloat32s4_7 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0.5)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			c := x[i]
			if c < -2 {
				c = -2
			} else if c > 2 {
				c = 2
			}
			s := 0.5 + c/4 - c*c*c/48
			dst[i] = x[i] * s
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1
				_t2 := _vcFloat32s4_1.IfElse(_t1.Less(_vcFloat32s4_1), _vcFloat32s4_3.IfElse(_t1.Greater(_vcFloat32s4_3), _t1))
				_t3 := _t2.Div(_vcFloat32s4_6).Add(_vcFloat32s4_7).Sub(_t2.Mul(_t2).Mul(_t2).Div(_vcFloat32s4_5))
				_v1.Mul(_t3).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

// The condition reads a second temporary, and a branch value reads the first.
func Mixed(dst, x []float64) {
	_vcFloat64s5_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(2)
	_vcFloat64s5_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(1)
	_vcFloat64s5_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(10)
	_vcFloat64s5_4 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(100)
	_vcFloat64s5_5 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(-10)
	if _loopvecOverlap(x, dst) {
		for i := range dst {
			a := x[i] * 2
			b := a + 1
			if b > 10 && a < 100 {
				a = a - b
			} else if b < -10 {
				a = -a
			}
			dst[i] = a + b
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(x[_i:])
				_t1 := _v1.Mul(_vcFloat64s5_1)
				_t2 := _t1.Add(_vcFloat64s5_2)
				_t3 := _t1.Sub(_t2).IfElse(_t2.Greater(_vcFloat64s5_3).And(_t1.Less(_vcFloat64s5_4)), _t1.Neg().IfElse(_t2.Less(_vcFloat64s5_5), _t1))
				_t3.Add(_t2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}

//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func HardSwish(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i] + 3
		if t < 0 {
			t = 0
		} else if t > 6 {
			t = 6
		}
		dst[i] = x[i] * t / 6
	}
}

func HardSigmoid(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i] + 3
		if t < 0 {
			t = 0
		}
		if t > 6 {
			t = 6
		}
		dst[i] = t / 6
	}
}

func ClampInt(dst, x []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		t := x[i]
		if t < lo {
			t = lo
		} else if t > hi {
			t = hi
		}
		dst[i] = t
	}
}

// SiLU is x*sigmoid(x), which needs exp. These two replace sigmoid with an
// approximation built from arithmetic: x/(1+|x|) scaled into (0,1), and a cubic
// polynomial of x clamped to [-2,2], where it still rises. They are about the
// same shape as SiLU, not equal to it; the test checks the rewrite, not the accuracy.
func SiLUSoftsign(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		a := x[i]
		if a < 0 {
			a = -a
		}
		dst[i] = x[i] * (0.5 + 0.5*x[i]/(1+a))
	}
}

func SiLUCubic(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		c := x[i]
		if c < -2 {
			c = -2
		} else if c > 2 {
			c = 2
		}
		s := 0.5 + c/4 - c*c*c/48
		dst[i] = x[i] * s
	}
}

// The condition reads a second temporary, and a branch value reads the first.
func Mixed(dst, x []float64) {
	for i := range dst {
		a := x[i] * 2
		b := a + 1
		if b > 10 && a < 100 {
			a = a - b
		} else if b < -10 {
			a = -a

-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 6 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"example.com/test"
)

var special = []float32{
	float32(math.NaN()), float32(math.Inf(1)), float32(math.Inf(-1)),
	0, float32(math.Copysign(0, -1)), -1, 1, 3, -3, 3.5, -3.5, 6, -6, 2.99, 100, -100,
}

func floats32(n int) []float32 {
	s := make([]float32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = special[(i*7+n)%len(special)]
	}
	return s
}

func floats64(n int) []float64 {
	s := make([]float64, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = float64(special[(i*5+n)%len(special)])
	}
	return s
}

func bits32(s []float32) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + uint64(math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	return h
}

func bits64(s []float64) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + math.Float64bits(v)
	}
	return h
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 2, 5, 8, 9, 16, 17, 33, 100} {
		d := make([]float32, n)
		test.HardSwish(d, floats32(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "HardSwish", bits32(d))
		test.HardSigmoid(d, floats32(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "HardSigmoid", bits32(d))

		test.SiLUSoftsign(d, floats32(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "SiLUSoftsign", bits32(d))
		test.SiLUCubic(d, floats32(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "SiLUCubic", bits32(d))

		x := make([]int32, n)
		for i := range x {
			x[i] = int32((i*37+n)%41) - 20
		}
		di := make([]int32, n)
		test.ClampInt(di, x, -5, 7)
		var sum int64
		for i, v := range di {
			sum += int64(v) * int64(i+1)
		}
		fmt.Println(n, "ClampInt", sum)

		m := make([]float64, n)
		test.Mixed(m, floats64(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "Mixed", bits64(m))
	}
}
